g.title: j172563611
g.text: I was not referring to myself specifically.

g.title: j2311052447
g.text: This is a bit of a surprise.

g.title: j1915129546
g.text: I am hardly going to be the one to sit here and judge you for it.

g.title: j2842063972
g.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.

g.title: j3615178498
g.text: That... I care about you a great deal. And that I was wondering if you would be interested in, well. I don't even know how the Orokin would describe it.

g.title: j1710223231
g.text: Honestly, never mind. I forgot after all that.

g.title: j1676430234
g.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion.

g.title: j2458979841
g.text: I'm glad you aren't holding it against me.

g.title: j2841706854
g.text: It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.

g.title: j2766592100
g.text: If you are trying to back out of the contract because you did not need to use your end of it, do not bother. It will not work.

g.title: j2187224988
g.text: Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.

g.title: j916006207
g.text: You may not believe me, but I care about you.

g.title: j2587631930
g.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.

g.title: j3315430591
g.text: You could have approached me to say something, Drifter darling... but I know I am not precisely the most affable of creatures at times.

g.title: j3643042723
g.text: I am merely saying, you may have more options than you think. But like any battle, they are won and lost on the approach.

g.title: j3654724392
g.text: If this is what you wish, then of course my answer is yes. A very eager yes.

g.title: j2615344210
g.text: Mm. Happens to the best of us.

g.title: j3240666784
g.text: I could not be more glad that you did, however.

g.title: j1496035294
g.text: Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!

g.title: j1587165160
g.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.

g.title: j4201507309
g.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.

g.title: j3343940020
g.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.

g.title: j1219788115
g.text: Not that I would know anything on the topic.

g.title: j1484212828
g.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.

g.title: j988148319
g.text: Well. If you wish to court the Devil of Tau, I am hardly one to say no. And I, of course, am not bothered by your previous romantic engagement.

g.title: j2302844114
g.text: Oh, my sweet Drifter. My dear, sweet, darling, Drifter... I do not know if you have noticed, but?

g.title: j3202830485
g.text: Well! This is a bit of a surprise.

g.title: j2310802748
g.text: Okay, fine. I'm lying to myself, and I'm only spending time with the Protoframes because I'm bored and lonely.

g.title: j3441254148
g.text: Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.

g.title: j114094681
g.text: I'm not trying to back out of our contract. I'm just saying that I really do care about you.

g.title: j1626565452
g.text: I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?

g.title: j2885857415
g.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.

g.title: j2228763375
g.text: You could have approached me to say something, Drifter darling... but I know I am not precisely the most affable of creatures at times.

g.title: j1428995298
g.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.

g.title: j2038586612
g.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.

g.title: j3973686913
g.text: The issue is far more in your current dalliance with the zealot whom you amuse yourself with. I hardly think they will take kindly to our "sharing" you.

g.title: j4080862039
g.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?

g.title: j1599736493
g.text: If you wish to court the Devil of Tau, I am hardly one to say no.

g.title: j3292465266
g.text: I am glad we are agreed.

g.title: j1815815717
g.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.

g.title: j3514303858
g.text: You may not believe me, but I care about you.

g.title: j3384401018
g.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.

g.title: j977061254
g.text: "Devil of Tau," "evil soulless cretin," "puerile beast," etcetera, etcetera.

g.title: j1423887988
g.text: But why make such an arrangement, unless...?

g.title: j1216651985
g.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.

g.title: j4287834809
g.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.

g.title: j949102660
g.text: You get the idea. I recommend choosing in this instance, I am afraid.

g.title: j1143850988
g.text: Unfortunately, there is one who will. And we both know who it is.

g.title: j2899843527
g.text: I made the deal because I was desperate to get this right.

g.title: j4072361030
g.text: I screwed it up last time. I couldn't run that risk again.

g.title: j2051261680
g.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.

g.title: j1466935853
g.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.

g.title: j1549760366
g.text: Trust me. In some situations, a compromise cannot be negotiated.

g.title: j1094621322
g.text: While I certainly do not mind "sharing" you, the zealot will. I fear in this instance, you will have to choose.

g.title: j3470401476
g.text: You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.

g.title: j3890774764
g.text: Not that I would know anything about the topic.

g.title: j4199068286
g.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.

g.title: j3899282824
g.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.

g.title: j2129269773
g.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion. How baffled I was.

g.title: j1625901981
g.text: Now? Now that I know the truth? Drifter, my Drifter... I could not be more glad that you did.
